name: 22038-multiturnimage-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one GPU on one node, no expert parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 384 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. One stream is one conversation of eight requests, so 384 requests is 48 conversations and 288 are scored.
workload: guidellm, eight-turn image conversations: one new 1920x1080 gradient JPEG (quality 85) and ~48 tokens of new text per turn, exactly 32 tokens generated, ignore_eos and temperature 0. Built as two data sources whose turn counts must agree -- synthetic_text with turns 8 and synthetic_image with images_per_request 8 -- because guidellm reads a numeric column suffix as a TURN, so image_0..image_7 is an eight-turn conversation of one image each and NOT one request carrying eight images; a turn-count mismatch produces malformed turns rather than an error. Each completed turn's image is replayed into the next turn's messages, so turn k arrives carrying k+1 images.
purpose: An 8B photo-chat assistant giving brief replies across eight-turn conversations, each turn bringing a new full-HD photo, for four concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# Pinned rather than left to the memory-dependent default.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

random-seed: 42
